notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to share a huge milestone: VTuber Plus has now passed [b]12,000 total purchases across Steam and itch.io[/b], with over [b]30,000 downloads[/b] and [b]150+ daily active users[/b]. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]None of this would be possible without our amazing community of streamers and creators. notes.title: We're back!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that VTuber Plus is officially back on Steam!
It's been a journey, but we're excited to finally bring it back to one of the biggest platforms out there.

That said, we want to make one thing clear: we're not moving away from Itch.
Both Itch.io and Steam will be official platforms where VTuber Plus is sold and supported. Choose whichever works best for you!

Thank you all so much for your patience, support, and continued love for VTuber Plus. We couldn’t have done this without you!

Stay awesome,
Arzolath

notes.title: VTuber Plus on Steam
notes.notes:
[h2]Finally moving to Steam[/h2]

[h3]Here's what you should expect from the Steam version (v3.6):[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added the option to change the timeout for thrown items.
[*] Added Steam integration.
[*] Added support for Steam Workshop (upload and browse).
[*] Added a notification for the avatars that use Standard shaders.
[*] Added extra tools and resources to Extras.
[*] Added a Head Pat reward.
[*] Added Head Pat adjustments to Avatar settings.
[*] Added emission map to the default items so they wont appear black in dark scenes.
[*] Added the possibility to combine different effects with the same trigger.
[*] Preventing the Follow rewards to get triggered by people unfollowing and following again.
[*] Upgraded to the latest UniVRM SDK.
[*] Licensing is removed.
[*] Device limit is removed.
[*] Improved Mesh detections.
[*] Fixed the issue where some VSF animations would not play or play incorrectly.
[*] Fixed the issue where shortcuts were accidentally triggered when typing in text boxes.
[*] Fixed the issue where the camera would reset on avatar switch.
[*] Fixed the issue where 2D props would cause unwanted collission.
[*] Fixed the issue where some VSF animations appear jittery.
[/list]


[h3]Here's what you should expect if you're migrating from itch:[/h3]

[list]
[*] If you have specific items or effects designed for you, they'd still work.
[*] If you have purchased extra licensing before, you'll receive an extra redeem key for Steam.
[*] You can not run VTuber Plus without Steam.
[*] You can run VTuber Plus along side other games.
[*] You can run VTuber Plus on a different machine using the Offline Mode if you're using the same Steam account on your main and secondary machine.
[*] Your old license key is now obsolete.
[*] You can save your Scene and Rewards and bring them over.
[*] Other settings like Avatars, Items, Ragdoll, etc. will be removed.
[/list]


[h3]Here's what you should expect if you're brand new to VTuber Plus:[/h3]

VTuber Plus has an amazing, active and helpful community of Streamers and even though the program is on a released state, you should expect constant updates, fixes and new features.

The best way to contact the developer and communicate with all the other Streamers is through the Discord server provided in the program itself.


[url=https://vtuberplus.com]VTuber Plus Documentation can be found here[/url]


[h2]VTuber Plus will be available on April 19th[/h2]
